entities.summary: Persian Afsharid, a notable figure in the history of Oman, associated with Ya'rubi Dynasty and Omani Maritime Empire (1719–1749). Preceded by Ya'rubi Civil War and Decline and Omanis capture Fort Jesus in Mombasa, ending Portuguese dominance in East Africa.
